fields.name: start
fields.description: The first day of the sprint; the sources sometimes give only a year or a month.

fields.name: end
fields.description: The last day of the sprint, in the same form as the start.

fields.name: organisers
fields.description: The ids of the organising persons in the people register. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: organisations
fields.description: The ids of the organising organisations in the organisations register. Several values are separated by semicolons.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Whether the sprint was a strategic or a community sprint.

fields.name: source
fields.description: A public record, linked as a web address, that supports the row.
